# Readonly installed pip source capture

One fresh, permanently consumed CPU case returned 495 selected `.py`/`.pyi` files (6,027,022 bytes) from the existing readonly pip 24.0 directory. Independent actual and preservation reviews accepted the narrow capture. This enables later review of the actual installed source/API/import contract. Dependency consistency remains unverified; pipcheck, pip/vendor execution, Torch, tensors, gradients, training, CUDA, GPU, queue, browser and external trials are zero. All seven broad authority fields remain false.

Source A `6ad63490cc5f92203df047e0083d5bc1f2093b4e` was integrated through [PR50](https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev/pull/50), merge `49935ef8a32c798701dbff43dd4ad6888698714b`, with source/main tree equality. Four latest exact-source push/PR matrix jobs passed on Python 3.10/3.14, attempt1. Each saved push log reports 1702 tests minus90 skips =1612 derived passes;42 unique new methods including5 strict Linux CLI cases were individually checked. This does not enumerate all1702 names or preserve ephemeral GitHub fixture products/receipt bodies. Accepted source/CI work and old host episodes were not repeated.

The new case used two SSH and one SCP invocations, all rc0, normal local directchild reap, no timeout/kill and empty stderr. These are invocation counts, not socket counts. Collector transport+observation took6.939194458 seconds; this is not model latency or performance. Original collector stdout is12,440,322 bytes, SHA256 `c6b5b4a54c7dc57f821dffd38ee92d23cfe27e69744ca2e98f15297abbca345d`, retained privately with raw source bodies. The case/root/nonce/request/attempt/PIDs/argv/outputs are consumed; there is no retry, resume, fallback or retrieval.

One recursive traversal with before/after scans of59 directories returned1268 yields covering634 unique entries (maximum depth4);495 selected source files were captured. Four explicit site scans each yielded149 entries; two76-distribution metadata snapshots each total974,333 bytes and agree. Pycache directory contents and excluded non-source files were not captured. Version metadata and equal snapshots do not establish dependency consistency, package importability, full installed payload, wheel bytes or an atomic snapshot.

`capture-manifest.json` is a root-authored path/count/SHA derivative. It contains no source bodies or producer stat tuples. `result.json` is an exact copy of the root final summary, not an independent remote receipt. Original source-freeze, prelaunch, manifest and code-integration creation-pending fields remain historical. The subsequent independent actual review supplies the narrow acceptance; pending publication fields refer to report creation. No complete pip/vendor tree, raw transport/CI/Git/API buffers or private staging is published.

Filesystem/syscall facts and marker fsync are controlled-source returned observations; no independently retrieved remote marker, receipt durability, per-FD-close syscall ledger, complete ancestry, mapped code or physical exclusion is certified. The producer does not separately serialize workfinish/postvalidation/emission-end clocks; rc0/candidate evidence from pinned reviewed source is the stated basis. Pre-t0 startup and blocking filesystem/stdlib calls are outside cooperative deadline guarantees. Numeric stdout flags are descriptive, with no independently authenticated O_NONBLOCK bit, architecture width or ABI claim. Local directchild cleanup does not guarantee remote descendant/observer/host-loss recovery.

The index separates original/public hashes and sizes. Actual caller-home replacements are counted; embedded hashes still describe originals. It excludes itself. Retained findings preserve the real source fixture gap, wrong CI verdict-key/sequential-cell error, numeric-bit assumption, caller storage undercount and reviewer reader SyntaxError. Failed originals remain private and unchanged.

Inherited201 opaque paths (166 tracked+35 nonGit, including26 data+9 run) and old2375 Git path/object/mode metadata retain accepted prior evidence. Three new source paths add to2378 Git entries and204 opaque paths; old blob/data/nonGit/rawCI/host body rescans are zero.
